test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 8 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In how many years will a sum of ₹4,000 be increased to ₹4,840 at 10% compound interest per annum?
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹4,000

Amount (A) = ₹4,840

Rate (r) = 10%

**Formula used:**

A = P × (1 + r/100)t

**Calculations:**

⇒ 4840 = 4000 × (1 + 10/100)t

⇒ 4840/4000 = (1.10)t

⇒ 1.21 = (1.10)t

Taking log on both sides:

⇒ log(1.21) = t × log(1.10)

⇒ t = log(1.21)/log(1.10)

⇒ t ≈ 2

**∴ The time required is approximately 2 years.**
